overview_description.description:
RevenueBase provides a revenue database as a service that delivers the data completeness and accuracy at scale to easily and successfully reach and engage with prospects.

Business executives can obtain more and better data that can be promptly translated into revenue development thanks to the company's analysis of clients' go-to-market opportunities and delivery of the right account and contact information through an up-to-date, simple-to-manage database.

RevenueBase was established on May 1, 2021 in Waltham, Massachusetts by Mark J. Feldman and Milenko Beslic.

about_short_description.short_description: RevenueBase is a provider of the database as a service intended to serve B2B companies.

product.name: RevenueBase B2B Database
product.description: A continuously verified and enriched database of global B2B company and contact information designed to support sales and marketing outreach.

product.name: RevenueBase Email Verification
product.description: An email verification service tailored for B2B data that ensures high accuracy, including catch-all and firewall-protected domains, to improve email deliverability.

product.name: RevenueBase Data Delivery via Gigasheet
product.description: A data delivery solution that provides customers with full, unrestricted access to the entire RevenueBase dataset through a spreadsheet-like interface for easy exploration and export.

product.name: RevenueBase Data Governance Framework Guidance
product.description: Consultative guidance and resources to help organizations establish and maintain data governance policies and frameworks for managing B2B data quality and compliance.

product.name: RevenueBase Partner Program
product.description: A partnership service that enables companies to integrate and resell RevenueBase’s B2B data to enhance their own products and offerings.
